description: Land Acquisition - Wedagama, Aththanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes lot numbers, land names, descriptions (garden, paddy field, etc.), claimants, original claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its land-related nature.
